scope: Offline analysis of released task-level outcomes, plus a portable reference runner for user-supplied task panels.

primary_methods.paired_binary_test: Two-sided exact McNemar/sign test on discordant paired outcomes.
primary_methods.holm: Step-down Holm adjustment within the paper-defined comparison family.
primary_methods.cluster_bootstrap: Resample repository clusters with replacement; compute percentile 95% intervals.
primary_methods.leave_one_repository_out: Recompute the paired effect after removing each repository cluster.

large_repository_matched_prompts.stream: one NumPy generator per cell; bootstrap draws precede sign flips

six_pair_note: For Qwen3/SERIAL/DISRUPT, the saved submitted analysis value is 6.99993e-05 (six exceedances). The seeded release recomputation is reported in a separate column; Monte Carlo estimates are not forced to equal the saved submitted value.
data_note: Repository identity is retained as a cluster key. Source text, prompts, final answers, raw outputs, trajectories, timestamps, and request hashes are excluded.
e04_submitted_procedure: The 180-repository analysis follows the recovered seed, sorted cell order, repository bootstrap, sign-flip, and Holm family that match the submitted Table 11 values at printed precision.
